title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, Shitet Apartament 3+1+2, Me Super Pamje!!
description_sq: Ne nje nga komplekset me te mira ne Tirane, tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, shitet super apartament 3+1+2. Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 123.4 m2, dhe siperfaqe neto 103.74 m2, organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje te bollshem dhe ambientin e gatimit te vecuar me dritare, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualetin e saj te dedikuar, dy dhoma gjumi femijesh, tualeti kryesor dhe lavanderia. Orientimi eshte nga Lindja cka e ben nje apartament te ekspozuar ndaj drites se diellit ne pjesen me te mire te dites ,gjithashtu ka dhe pamje te lire nga qyteti. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone e cila eshte shume e kerkuar pasi ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per nje jetese sa me komode, me ajer te paster dhe nje zone mjaft e qete. Kompleksi aksesohet dhe nga linja e transportit publik qe te sjelle deri tek hyrja e rezidences. Apartamenti pervec faktit qe eshte shume i pershtatshem per banim eshte shume i pershtatshem edhe per investim pasi zona ka kerkesa te larta qiraje.
title_en: At Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, with great view!!
description_en: In one of the best complexes in Tirana, at Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, a super apartment 3+1+2 is for sale. The apartment with a total area of ​​123.4 m2, and a net area of ​​103.74 m2, is organized in a spacious living room and a separate kitchen area with windows, a matrimonial bedroom with its dedicated toilet, two children's bedrooms, the main toilet and laundry room. The orientation is from the East, which makes the apartment exposed to sunlight for the best part of the day, it also has a clear view of the city. The area in which the apartment is located is an area that is very sought after as it offers all the necessary services for a comfortable life, with clean air and a quite quiet area. The complex is also accessed by the public transport line that brings you to the entrance of the residence. Apart from the fact that it is very suitable for living, the apartment is also very suitable for investment, since the area has high rent requirements.
